note_en: 被 marks a passive sentence, where the subject is on the receiving end of the action: 老张被推回病房 "Lao Zhang was wheeled back to the ward." Like English "was + past participle," but Chinese can name the doer right after 被 (被护士推回病房) or leave it out, and the verb never changes form.
